calls.reasoning: Consensus for MSFT Q1 FY27 (Sep-2026 quarter, reports Oct 28) is ~$4.71-4.72 (Zacks 4.67). calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the facts: consensus ~4.72, the report date of Oct 28, and the FY26 beat history. One run cited a stale MarketBeat 4.15; the others show 4.71, so 4.15 was discarded. The main open factual issue is GAAP vs non-GAAP; the blank criteria mean it cannot be settled. Recent quarters had small OpenAI GAAP impacts, so I kept the center on the non-GAAP-style estimate and widened the lower tail. Runs 2 and 3 centered at 4.96-4.97 on a 5% beat. I shade to 4.94 because the Q4-underlying-plus-seasonality cross-check (4.70-4.83) argues against a large beat. No new Anthropic or OpenAI valuation event in Jul-Sep was found, so no repeat one-off gain is assumed. The reference class and dispersion broadly carry forward from the runs. No web retrieval was done on this run.
